# Goal: a hole with a green rim, and a flag (a slate pole, a red pennant) standing behind it.
# Origin at the hole's centre on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pit --base-color 0.2706 0.1686 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.7765 0.8000 0.3294 --no-slot
material new Pole --base-color 0.3373 0.3294 0.4314 --no-slot
material new Flag --base-color 0.9412 0.3569 0.3569 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pit --vertices 12 --radius 0.38 --depth 0.02 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Pit
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh torus --name Rim --major-segments 14 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.45 --minor-radius 0.09 --location 0 0 0.06
material assign Rim
add mesh cylinder --name Pole --vertices 6 --radius 0.06 --depth 1.6 --location 0.0 0.6 0.8
material assign Pole
add mesh cube --name Flag --size 1 --location 0.36 0.6 1.32
scale 0.66 0.08 0.48
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0.2"
scale 1 1 0.25
mode object
material assign Flag
shade flat
export goal.glb
